# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains a large number of short call fragments from the Crayon Roofing & Structures (Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai) sales/dealer line. A significant share of the recordings are **not genuine sales calls** — they are internal logistics (vehicle/driver dispatch, Porter bookings, gate/security coordination), Diwali gift-distribution coordination to dealers, bill-copy/outstanding follow-ups, and misdialed numbers. These have been excluded from the analysis below.

The **real sales signal** comes from roughly 40–50 usable fragments covering: (1) inbound roofing-sheet enquiries (JSW brand variants, thickness/length/color questions, quotation requests), (2) B2B dealer/fabricator calls negotiating coil rate, screws, and welding rods, (3) accessory/diagram clarification calls (L-flash, cutters, ridges), (4) one long strategic call between a field rep and a struggling dealer about distribution economics and competitors, and (5) a few polycarbonate/PUFF panel enquiries. Many calls are incomplete — customer says a requirement, rep says "WhatsApp-ல அனுப்புறேன்" and the call ends, so conversion/closing data is thin. This KB is grounded only in what is explicitly said; where a rate or term appears only once, it is flagged as such.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core product: Metal roofing sheets (profiled/corrugated steel coils, factory in Manali)**
- Brands/lines mentioned as *Crayon's own*: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragati/Pragathi**, **JSW Radiance**, **Silver On Plus**, **Asian Indradhanush (Indira Dhanush)** — "Asian-ல தான் பண்ணுவாங்க" is said about a *competitor* (Amar/Everlast), so Asian Indradhanush at Crayon is their own coil-fed line.
- Thickness ladder actually quoted: **0.45 mm → 0.47 mm → 0.50 mm → 0.6 mm**. 0.7 mm was explicitly told "இல்ல sir, 0.6 mm-ல தான் இருக்கு" (not stocked).
- Colors repeatedly quoted: sky blue, off white (9002 half-white), royal blue, grey/dark green ("Kali Shelt Green"), terracotta.
- Accessories made to diagram: **L-flash, gutter, ridge, crimp, cutter/corner pieces** — all billed off a **standard width of 610 mm**; anything wider is billed as "full sheet" (effectively double rate), e.g. a 900 mm (300+300+300) cutter was corrected from ₹1310 down to ₹655 once confirmed as 610 mm standard.

**Polycarbonate / FRP sheets**
- Brand: **Lexan**. Thicknesses stocked: **1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm**; "clear 10 mm" was quoted for one customer at ₹61+tax per sq ft (likely a different clear acrylic SKU, separate from Lexan line).
- **Standard max length = 15 ft** for transparent polycarbonate sheet; roofing-profile sheets (non-transparent) can be made to any requested length, but customer must arrange suitable transport for long lengths.

**PUFF panels (insulated roof + wall panel)**
- Separate product line, made at a "வேற factory" (not the Manali metal-sheet unit). 50 mm / 40 mm / 30
